dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Oho... Such a cool texture, and what a refreshing aftertaste. Just like placing your hand on a machine that's just been wiped clean...

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: Ahh, the smell of steel, as fresh as a handful of Mint!

dialogues.speaker: Shana
dialogues.text: ...Of course, you can eat Mint, but I'd advise against actually trying to taste an ice-cold Iron Chunk.
